title: Cheapest Tauranga Gyms
meta_desc: Discover the cheapest no-contract gyms in Tauranga, with prices and the Exercise NZ subsidy — compare City Fitness, Les Mills and more popular chains.
intro: Tauranga's fitness scene is thriving, with a range of affordable gym options available. City Fitness offers the best value, with a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week. For those looking for no-contract alternatives, Anytime Fitness provides 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide. The Exercise NZ subsidy programme also offers 40-70% off for eligible members, making it the biggest discount available for New Zealanders.

sections.heading: Most Affordable Options
sections.body: For budget-conscious individuals, City Fitness is the cheapest option in Tauranga, with a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week. This membership includes access to a full-service gym with a range of equipment and group fitness classes. Another affordable option is Anytime Fitness, which offers 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide, with no lock-in contract.
list: Anytime Fitness: prices vary (no lock-in contract)

sections.heading: No-Contract Alternatives
sections.body: Anytime Fitness is a popular choice for those who want the flexibility of a no-contract membership. With 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide, members can work out at any time that suits them. Les Mills also offers a Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract, providing access to a range of group fitness classes and equipment.
list: Anytime Fitness: 24/7 access, no lock-in contract
Les Mills: Flexi Membership, no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy
sections.body: Eligible members can apply for the subsidy through the Exercise NZ website, and once approved, can redeem their discount at participating gyms, including City Fitness and Anytime Fitness.
